name: OSM Context Epoch Source
description: The serving half of the OpenStreetMap context lane (plan "OpenStreetMap on SDN", 2026-09-03; owner decision: hosted as FlatGeobuf). One method, route: a $HTQ HttpRequest enters, and exactly one $HTR HttpResponse leaves. The mount is a PREFIX only (config key osm_mount_path, default /api/v1/osm/); a path that does not start with it is a 404. "tileset.json" renders the epoch record the off-fleet builder (space-data-network-modules/tools/osm-context/build-fgb.mjs) wrote for the pinned epoch - the same document, verbatim from config key osm_epoch_record (an object), with PAYLOAD.CID set from osm_epoch_cid and EPOCH_BASE_PATH added as a path RELATIVE to this node's origin (<gateway path>/<cid>/), so no client learns a hostname or hardcodes an epoch; public max-age=60, strong ETag (sha2-256 multihash of the body), 304 on If-None-Match, access-control-allow-origin *. "" and "catalogue.json" answer the camelCase discovery document (epochId, delivery, cid, datasetEpoch, epochBasePath, recordPath, format osm-context-fgb/1, attribution). Without an epoch configured the record route answers 503 naming the missing keys (osm_epoch_record, osm_epoch_cid) rather than a fabricated record. Anything else is a no-store 404; non-GET/HEAD is 405. The FlatGeobuf bytes never pass through this module: clients range-read <origin>/ipfs/<cid>/<file>.fgb from the gateway. capabilities [], browser + wasmedge, request-scoped, config read once per instance over plugin.getConfig (the sanctioned bridge terrain-source uses) or handed in on the optional "config" port.

sequentialJustification.detail: route is a single-pass transform over one request frame: parse, match the mount prefix, render one small JSON body from configuration, hash it for the ETag. No shared mutable state beyond the once-per-instance config cache, no worker pool and no fan-out inside the guest, so it compiles single-thread rather than claiming a wasi-threads contract it does not honour.

methods.displayName: Route one OSM context HTTP request

acceptedTypeSets.description: The mount's serving config, the same JSON object plugin.getConfig returns. Optional: absent, route reads it over the host bridge.

wildcardJustification.detail: Intra-flow control frame produced and consumed inside this flow; its shape is defined by the host op, not by SDS.

inputPorts.description: OPTIONAL serving config, handed in instead of read over plugin.getConfig, so a host-bridge-less artifact (parity lanes, tests) can execute the record surface.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Canonical WASM-served HTTP response envelope ($HTR). The host streams it back verbatim.

outputPorts.description: The one response: the epoch record, the discovery document, a 304, a 404, a 405 or a 503.

methods.description: One $HTQ in, exactly one $HTR out. See the plugin description for the routes and the cache policy.
